How they can work together

Illustrative voice-assistant architecture. A real deployment may use only some of these components.

01 · NPU hears

A supported on-device model processes speech locally.

02 · DPU connects

In a suitably equipped server, infrastructure offloads handle network and security work.

03 · CPU coordinates

Application logic prepares input and schedules the model workload.

04 · Accelerator answers

A GPU, TPU or specialized inference system processes the supported model.
